references.text: Zebul, the ruler of the city, told Abimelech about Gaal's rebellious words and set up the ambush that Gaal now encounters.
The men of Shechem had previously laid an ambush against Abimelech, but now the situation reverses as Abimelech himself uses an ambush.
Abimelech uses the same ambush tactic again later in the chapter to attack the people of Shechem.
Joshua used a similar military strategy with an ambush during the conquest of Ai.
Israel used the same ambush strategy against Benjamin at Gibeah.
The city gate was an important meeting place for public affairs and defense, which is why Gaal positioned himself there.
